Anorexia, the practice of severely restricting one's caloric intake, is a manifestation of extreme self-control and discipline. It's an artful dance of turning down the volume on hunger and listening to the whispers of our bodies. By curbing our appetites, we can create a space within ourselves for introspection and self-discovery. It's like turning off the noise of the world and focusing on the whispers of our true selves.

Bulimia, on the other hand, involves undoing the effects of anorexia by bingeing and purging.
